subject: POC performance run — temporary credit uplift for evening soak
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@orchard.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary uplift for POC evening soak

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the model latency looked promising. We're planning a stress soak this Thursday night (Jun 17) to validate sustained tail latency at our target 800 concurrent sessions and roughly 140 QPS sustained for 6 hours.

We ran an initial daytime run on lower concurrency and saw the behavior we expected, but the evening soak will include larger prompt sizes and KV cache churn. To run the validation without throttling on your platform we'd need a temporary credit uplift or a promotional allowance that covers the additional token consumption for the test window.

High-level ask: 160k additional token-equivalent credits to cover the 6-hour soak (estimates attached in the POC plan). Can you advise what form that can take (promo code, temporary quota bump, trial extension) and any internal approvals needed? We also want to confirm whether the soak will be routed to Dedicated vs Hosted for consistent latency.

Attached: orchard_poc_plan.pdf (traffic profile + expected token calc).

Appreciate a quick note on feasibility and the timeline — we're aiming to run on 2027-06-17 01:00 - 07:00 UTC.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Grant
Head of ML Ops, Orchard Analytics
O: 415-555-0142

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@orchard.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary uplift for POC evening soak

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear plan and the attachment.

Short answer: we can provision a temporary uplift for that window, but I need to confirm two things before we lock it in:
1) Whether you need Dedicated routing for the whole window (that has different allocation steps).
2) An explicit acceptance of promotional terms for the uplift (we handle it as a credit grant tied to the ORCH-POC-2027-06 deal).

Initial proposal from our side: a provisional 160k token-equivalent promo credit valid for 2027-06-17 00:00 to 2027-06-18 00:00 UTC to cover the soak and a short buffer. If Dedicated routing is required, we can pin you to a dedicated pool for the window and coordinate capacity with infra, but that requires APAC/US capacity checks — Soojin, can you validate pool availability for 17 June evening PST?

Neha — would Finance need any paperwork for a promotional credit of this size (we're not invoicing, just granting a one-off promo tied to the POC)? If so, I'll loop the customer through the minimal acceptance doc. I've attached a draft promo-credit-agreement.txt that outlines terms (timebox, non-transferable, redemption window).

Sophie — can you confirm: (a) final traffic profile (I glanced at orchard_poc_plan.pdf, but please highlight any changes), and (b) whether you accept the promo terms? Once confirmed we'll create the grant and paste the promo code into the HubSpot deal.

– Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: promo-credit-agreement.txt (draft terms)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sophie Grant <sophie@orchard.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary uplift for POC evening soak

On Thu, Jun 10, 2027 at 4:03 PM, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Initial proposal from our side: a provisional 160k token-equivalent promo credit valid for 2027-06-17 00:00 to 2027-06-18 00:00 UTC to cover the soak and a short buffer.

Thanks Marcus — quick capacity check: I confirmed with infra that we can reserve a small Dedicated slice for Orchard during the window in us-west-2; it will be a short-lived pin and should not impact other customers. I'll need a heads-up by EOD Monday (2027-06-14) to lock the pool and schedule the autoscale hold.

Security note for Sophie: we will not share customer data outside your tenant; still, if you can provide the SOC2 snapshot we use that for our internal checklist — attached SOC2-snapshot.pdf.

Operational flow (for clarity):
- Sophie accepts promo terms (reply with ACK)
- Marcus files the promo grant to HubSpot and notes the code in the deal
- I file a capacity pin request to infra with the window and request they hold the pool on Jun 17 UTC
- On the morning of Jun 17 we flip routing to the Dedicated slice for your test and flip back when finished

Sophie — if that works, reply ACK and we'll proceed. I'll also open the internal infra ticket and share the scheduling ID.

— Soojin
Sojiin Lee
Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot.pdf
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@orchard.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary uplift for POC evening soak

Hi Marcus / Soojin — ACK.

We accept the promo terms in promo-credit-agreement.txt and confirm the traffic profile in orchard_poc_plan.pdf (no changes). Please proceed with the 160k token promo grant and the Dedicated slice reservation for 2027-06-17 00:00 to 2027-06-18 00:00 UTC.

Can you paste the promo code in the HubSpot deal and share the infra scheduling ID once you have it? Also, if there are any operational runbooks or simple health-check scripts you recommend we run before the soak, that would be helpful — we plan a 30-minute dry run two hours before the main window.

Thanks — Sophie
